start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-one-notice-list-to-a-persons-ais with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"}, adds [{\"kind\": \"tell\", \"key\": \"d\", \"said\": \"four\"}] and unseen_for [\"app:Codex\"]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the notices and the reader cursors are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-one-notice-list-to-a-persons-ais" with store, rules, adds, sees and unseen_for. Send the numbers from the person's settings, never invented ones.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example notices and cursor moves: every answer must match, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps each new notice once, moves each cursor only from the value it was read at, and reads each reader's unseen notices.
